usedFor: Follow Up Boss holds leads and deals, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers when “New Deal Created” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Created” in Follow Up Boss, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new deal starts a command you have set up on your own computer.

watchOut: “Contact Is Updated” in Follow Up Boss runs on every update, so “Trigger Command” could run often for one contact.
